payload.objective: The test test_calculator.py fails. Fix the formula bug in src/calculator.py so all tests pass.

payload.detail:
from src.calculator import calculate_value

def test_formula():
    assert calculate_value(2, 3) == 15
    assert calculate_value(0, 4) == 16
    assert calculate_value(1, 1) == 2
